title: Service-Failure Reduction of ClearPath Exit Fees
content:
**Rule.** The service-failure reduction of the early termination fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement counts the service credits posted on the agreement in the last 6 months (a month window ending today):
- 3 or more take 25.0 percent off;
- one up to 2 take 10.0 percent off;
- none takes nothing off.

A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today. The credits counted are the service credit entries on the agreement's billing ledger, by posting date.

**Basis questions.**

*Today is 2025-07-15 and a credit was posted 2025-01-15.* It is 6 whole months old and outside the window.

*Credits posted 2025-01-16, 2025-03-02 and 2025-06-30, today 2025-07-15.* Three in the window: 25.0 percent off.

*A single credit in the window.* 10.0 percent off.
